title: Aggregated synteny blocks for one genome pair
description: One row per syntenic block between a reference and a query genome. Aggregated from raw wfmash PAF alignments by a pipeline-side script. The atlas reads this through Mode B (raw-folder interface). See data/cross_species/README.md for the pair-naming convention (`<ref>__vs__<query>`).

identity.description: Mean per-base identity within the block.

n_alignments.description: Number of underlying wfmash alignments aggregated into this block.
